Capacity (MW).note: The Regierung von Oberbayern permit of 26 September 2023 allows Onyx to build a gas engine plant at the Zolling site with five engines of 12.52 MW electric each. That adds up to 62.6 MW. GEM shows 42 MW. The permit does not use the unit name, so I matched it to this unit by site, owner and engine type.

Latest Activity.note: A press release of 13 May 2024 from the Regierung von Oberbayern says the gas pipeline for the Zolling gas engine plant was approved by a decision dated 2 May 2024. I found no later report of work on this plant.

Status Detail.value: permit granted September 2023, gas pipeline approved May 2024, no construction reported
Status Detail.note: The engine plant permit is dated 26 September 2023 and the gas pipeline approval is dated 2 May 2024. I found no report that building has started, so the status stays pre-construction.

units.notes: The permit and the gas pipeline approval show the project is moving but not yet built. I could not find a start date or the engine maker. The only hint is an oil data sheet for Jenbacher engines in the permit file, which is not enough to name the model.

Latest Activity.note: A Bavarian economics ministry press release of 7 May 2026 says the minister signed a letter of intent with Onyx for a combined cycle plant of about 800 MW at Zolling. The plant is meant to be built under the first capacity tender of the new StromVKG law.

Status Detail.value: letter of intent signed with Bavarian state in May 2026, planned for first StromVKG capacity tender, permits and detailed design still to come
Status Detail.note: The ministry press release and a Bayern Innovativ article both say the plant depends on the tender and that further permits and technical planning are still open. I did not find a report that Onyx submitted a bid on 8 September 2026, and no award list exists yet.

Capacity (MW).note: The ministry press release of 7 May 2026 gives about 800 MW. This matches GEM and is a source not already cited.

Turbine/Engine Technology.note: The ministry press release calls the plant a gas and steam turbine plant, which is a combined cycle plant.

units.notes: The project is still announced. I could not find a start year. A statement about Zolling's relevance beyond 2031 is not a commissioning date. No turbine maker or permit application was found.

qa.recommendation: Check whether the owner should be Onyx Wärmekraftwerk Zolling GmbH.
qa.note: The permit for the gas engine plant was issued to Onyx Wärmekraftwerk Zolling GmbH. The regulator's power plant list names Onyx Kraftwerk Zolling GmbH und Co. KGaA as operator of the existing units. GEM shows Onyx Germany GmbH. I did not change the owner because I found no dated ownership document.

qa.recommendation: Confirm that the 42 MW in GEM is out of date and that 62.6 MW is right.
qa.note: The permit lists five engines of 12.52 MW electric each. Another permit line speaks of up to 70 MW in total. The 42 MW in GEM has no source I could find.
